//: What: npm manifest of the MTX sidecar - a separate CAP app that subscribes, upgrades and unsubscribes tenants (one database each) and accepts tenant extensions, with the extension rules (x_ prefix, only Notes may get up to 3 new fields).

Why: [CAP-M20] [CAP-M21] the sidecar keeps the tenant lifecycle out of the app process (as generated by cds add multitenancy). In development it reads the app model from ../.. and uses the app's mocked users; the extension linter reads its rules from this file.
If missing or unlinked: No tenant can be subscribed - the multitenant app answers every request without a tenant database.
name: sample-multitenant-saas-mtx
